Instruction for accurate documentation of test results

1. Use the test records at the back of the User Guide. 2. Fill in the Appliance Details. 3. Fill in the visual inspection and testing. 4. Fill in test results.

Appliances with non-replaceable fuses

Appliance supplied with non-replaceable fuses shall not be opened for any reason.

Without fuse

The appliances are designed not to require a fuse except where specified.

Testing without fuse

For double insulation appliances, the insulation test is to be skipped as per EICR.

Quotable quotes

* “Safety should always be a priority.” * “Test to ensure safety.” * “Electrics should never be taken for granted.” * “Do not take risks with safety.” * “Do not ever put your safety at risk.”
